operations_plan.summary: Convert the opposed shallow rounded-end vertical relief pockets in the lower upright support into one continuous through-slot. Preserve the existing slot profile, position, orientation, exterior frame geometry, base, C-opening, upper housing, and boss.

steps.description: Identify the front and rear vertical rounded-end relief pockets as the two sides of the requested slot. Confirm that their profiles are aligned and congruent along the local body-thickness direction, normal to their planar pocket floors. Use the front pocket floor (face 23 at z=-10) and rear pocket floor (face 18 at z=-32) to establish the cut axis and verify that the remaining material between these floors is the central web to be removed. The target is section_relief_pockets, while section_c_frame is the solid region intersected by the final cut.

Create or edit the slot-cut profile on a plane parallel to the broad front and rear faces of the upright, preferably using planar pocket floor face 23 as the sketch support. Project the complete existing front pocket perimeter formed by straight side walls 19 and 21 and rounded end walls 20 and 22 into the sketch. Constrain the projected profile to retain its current width, height, rounded-end radii, vertical orientation, and center location. Do not offset, resize, or reposition the profile. Cross-check the projected profile against the rear pocket boundary formed by faces 14, 15, 16, and 17; if minor model tolerances exist, retain the front profile as the controlling geometry while keeping it coaxial with the rear recess.

Apply a subtractive pocket/extrude operation to the preserved rounded-end slot profile with a Through All extent along the local thickness direction. Use a symmetric through-all cut, or equivalent Through All in both directions, so the tool passes through every intersected portion of solid 0 from the front exterior skin to the rear exterior skin. This removes the central web between pocket floors 23 and 18 and eliminates both pocket-floor faces, joining the existing front and rear recesses into one continuous opening. The resulting slot walls must follow the existing straight and semicylindrical boundaries without adding draft, chamfers, fillets, or dimensional changes.

Regenerate and validate the modified solid. Confirm that the former pocket-floor faces 18 and 23 no longer exist, that the slot is open and visible from both opposing broad side faces, and that its side and rounded-end walls form one continuous through-thickness cut. Verify that solid 0 remains a single valid connected solid. Confirm no changes to the base plate and mounting holes, the central C-shaped opening, the upright exterior contour and base transitions, the upper housing, the transverse cross-hole, or the top boss and axial bore.
